gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-wix-madefor-text: Wix Madefor Text keeps its terminals open and friendly. Under Shantell Sans, with its wobbly, one-width marker strokes, the body reads smoothly paragraph after paragraph, a plain sans that never fights the heading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ysabeau: Loose, hand-drawn swagger up top, then sweeping curves below. Shantell Sans has curves as heavy as its stems, like cord, while Ysabeau lets its lighter sans strokes flow across the page.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ysabeau-infant: Shantell Sans has a wide, gaping mouth and strokes cut at a single marker width, which gives it a playful look. Ysabeau Infant's outward-pointing terminals keep the sans-serif text quieter beneath.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ysabeau-office: Shantell Sans draws its curves exactly as thick as its stems, like a marker held at one angle. Ysabeau Office takes the opposite job, with open-ended curves that make a plain sans easy to follow line after line.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-ysabeau-sc: Marker-drawn and cheeky, with one stroke width throughout. Shantell Sans handles the attention-grabbing, while Ysabeau SC, a sans with a visibly gaping c, does the patient work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zalando-sans: Shantell Sans looks like outlines traced with one fat pen. Zalando Sans, a sans with open-ended curves, keeps a long stretch of text moving smoothly and without any fuss.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zalando-sans-exp: Zalando Sans Expanded spreads its letters wide, with c tips that never creep toward touching. Shantell Sans adds a hand-drawn wobble above, and a slightly larger body size would let those gaps breathe.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zalando-sans-sem: Playful, almost neon-tube in its uniform strokes, Shantell Sans leads the way. Zalando Sans SemiExpanded follows with open-mouthed curves on c, e, and s, so a plain sans runs along comfortably for as long as you keep reading.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Rope-like strokes, loose and a bit mischievous. Shantell Sans keeps every stem, bowl, and tail the same width, while ZCOOL XiaoWei adds a modest pencil-line taper that tidies up the sans text beneath it.
gen-gf-shantell-sans-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-: Shantell Sans brings a wide-mouthed, marker-drawn personality to the top of the page. Zen Kaku Gothic Antique is a plain sans with smooth bends and a matching-weight t, so a slightly generous body size suits it well.
